apps.localizedDescription: RHYSEN brings your daily tasks, work routines, reminders and automations together in one place. Built around a central dashboard, it helps reduce repetitive actions, keep important information accessible and make everyday routines easier to manage.

versions.localizedDescription:
WHAT'S NEW

Work setup
• Added a four-step setup for new jobs.

Work settings
• Made Commute, Shift Settings, and Pay expandable, with only one section open at a time.
• Simplified pay descriptions.

Refinements
• Added two-week estimated pay for biweekly jobs when the next week's schedule is available.
• Made Work Summary and habit color sheets size to their content.
• Made Actual Time in Task Details a single-row card that expands when tapped.
• Simplified habit reminder and counter wording.
• Aligned Work's header with Today's header, including glass buttons and content spacing.

BUG FIXES

• Fixed completed work shifts blocking new tasks after an early clock-out, including same-minute completion.
• Corrected biweekly estimates so overtime is calculated separately for each week.
• Addressed background habit buttons reacting during sheet dismissal while preserving their glass interaction.
• Prevented Today's header from reacting while Work is open.
